title: Learning from Unreliable Operator References: Claim-Level Rewards for Customer Support Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.34341v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Even a correct operator reply can be an unreliable training target for a customer-support agent. About a quarter of the factual claims in these replies lacked full support in the agent's knowledge base and tool records. We treat operator replies as claims to verify rather than answers to imitate. Unverified claims guide revisions to the knowledge base and tools. Verified claims serve as coverage targets in a claim-level GRPO reward that scores factual precision against the evidence the agent retrieved for its answer. On an offline benchmark, 8.6% of the GRPO agent's text answers were flagged for hallucinations, compared with 13.6% for the supervised fine-tuning baseline. In a randomized A/B test against the existing procedural bot, the deployed system increased the share of conversations closed without a human operator from 63.3% to 80.8%.

translated_title: 从不可靠的客服坐席参考中学习：面向客户支持智能体的声明级奖励
translated_abstract: 即使是正确的客服坐席回复，对于客户支持智能体而言也可能是一个不可靠的训练目标。这些回复中约有四分之一的事实性声明在智能体的知识库和工具记录中缺乏完整支持。我们将客服坐席的回复视为需要验证的声明，而非需要模仿的答案。未经验证的声明用于指导知识库和工具的修订；已验证的声明则作为声明级GRPO奖励中的覆盖目标，该奖励根据智能体为其答案所检索到的证据来评估事实精确度。在一个离线基准测试中，GRPO智能体的文本答案中有8.6%被标记为幻觉，而监督微调基线的这一比例为13.6%。在与现有程序化机器人的随机A/B测试中，部署的系统将无需人工坐席介入即可解决的对话比例从63.3%提升至80.8%。
tldr: 该论文提出将客服坐席回复视为待验证的声明而非模仿目标，通过声明级GRPO奖励机制过滤不可靠的训练信号，显著降低了幻觉率，并将无需人工介入的对话解决率从63.3%提升至80.8%。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes treating operator replies as claims to verify rather than answers to imitate, using a claim-level GRPO reward to filter unreliable training signals, which reduced hallucination rates and increased human-free conversation resolution from 63.3% to 80.8% in deployment.
